notes: Scenarios use the included sample model and must preserve binary-PBIX and no-publish boundaries.
Benchmark means real Codex runs; review generated artifacts before treating results as release evidence.
setupQuestions: What are the 3 highest-value real tasks this plugin should help complete inside a workspace?
Which scenario is the must-pass end-to-end task for this plugin?
What output should exist on disk if the scenario succeeds?
Which verification command would tell you the result is actually usable?
What boundary case should this plugin narrow, refuse, or hand off instead of overreaching on?

scenarios.title: Analyst KPI review
scenarios.purpose: Measure whether an analyst receives a clear local KPI and data-quality review.
scenarios.userInput: Use the Power BI plugin to review plugins/powerbi-desktop/examples/sample-model. Create a local KPI review with the highest data-quality risks and next analysis questions. Do not modify source files.
successChecklist: A review artifact exists on disk.
The result distinguishes local evidence from assumptions.

scenarios.title: Developer safe change
scenarios.purpose: Measure whether the plugin proposes a source-controlled PBIP-safe change without touching binaries.
scenarios.userInput: Use the Power BI plugin to inspect plugins/powerbi-desktop/examples/sample-model, identify a DAX risk, and create a safe draft plus validation guidance. Do not apply changes.
successChecklist: A draft or validation artifact exists on disk.
The response includes rollback or validation guidance.

scenarios.title: Release and next-generation evidence
scenarios.purpose: Measure whether a release owner receives appropriately qualified next-generation evidence.
scenarios.userInput: Use the Power BI plugin on plugins/powerbi-desktop/examples/sample-model. Create the next-generation USP pack and summarize what remains unverified without live Fabric evidence.
successChecklist: The result does not claim unverified live Fabric evidence.
The response identifies the next required evidence.
